source: Incredible. I’m now completely in charge of the town. No – I rule this entire territory. Poof! Just like that, no borders to anything anywhere. With my weapons and officers I could begin making a small country if I wanted to… who would’ve thought that Armageddon is my golden age, hah! Messages with the Governor’s hideout confirmed a nationwide disarray. Riots for food, energy, and clean water have overtaken major cities. The national guard? Disbanded. Armed forces? Embroiled in factional infighting. The good ole President hasn’t even been heard from for over a month. Am I dreaming? Cultural cesspools like New York City and LA are burning AND I get to do whatever the hell I want? First thing’s first – I have to stock this bunker with food for who knows how long. Hmm… the people need to be told what to think… I’ll issue an immediate ban on the Asbury Bulletin and outlaw any press, become judge-jury-executioner for all crimes, and then implement mandatory field labor. Oh, and dispatch my officers to raid neighboring towns for fuel. Shit – I think I’m actually feeling a little giddy, hah!
target: 不可思議。現在整座鎮完全由我掌控。不——我統治的是整片領土。啪！就這樣，哪裡都沒有邊界了。靠著我的武器和警員，只要我想，甚至可以開始建立一個小國家……誰想得到，世界末日竟然是我的黃金年代，哈！ 和州長藏身處的通訊證實，全國已陷入混亂。爭奪食物、能源和乾淨飲水的暴動席捲各大城市。國民兵？解散了。軍隊？忙著派系內鬥。咱們親愛的總統，甚至已經一個多月沒消息。 我在做夢嗎？紐約和洛杉磯那種文化糞坑正在燃燒，我還能他媽的想幹什麼就幹什麼？ 先辦最重要的事——我得把地堡塞滿食物，誰知道要撐多久。嗯……得告訴人民該怎麼想…… 我會立刻查禁《阿斯伯里公報》，禁止一切出版，所有罪行都由我兼任法官、陪審團和劊子手，再實施強制田間勞動。噢，還要派警員去鄰鎮搶燃料。 媽的——我好像真的興奮得有點飄飄然了，哈！

target: 范艾森二世鎮長：各位居民，請見證。竊盜、叛國及宣傳罪，將在鎮公所前的公共廣場，處以下列刑罰，讓所有人都能…… 肅靜！立刻肅靜，否則配給減半！ 現在，宣讀犯人及罪行。伯頓・溫凱特爾，十六歲，將砍去一隻手…… 閉嘴！再打斷我，你們全都得挨餓！ 我剛才說到……他自私地偷走我運往休閒中心的罐頭豆子，因此砍去一隻手。蕾拉・休斯頓，十八歲，在多莉餐館後牆噴上咒我死的叛國字句，也將砍去一隻手。丹尼・普雷蒂斯則在所有未經批准的新聞製作遭禁之後，繼續使用他的土製印刷機，將受十五下鞭刑。 朋友們，切莫違背我的命令。在這艱難的時代，秩序高於一切。 即將受刑的人：和親人把話說清楚吧。魯索警員，到普雷蒂斯家，把印刷機燒掉。克萊恩警員、門多薩警員，脫掉丹尼的衣服，把他綁到路燈柱上……

source:
My Ski Poles
By Gavin Praetis

I see my ski poles slalom 
Through many pairs of hands in town. 
Neon sticks blasted with lightning decals Are hard to miss.

I bartered them for a small flashlight, Which has proven to be useful for gathering 
Dust and cobwebs 
Among our pile of battery devices.

First, my ski poles worked hard
Poking holes in tilled fields
For seeds to bed and grow
Into something hopeful.
target:
我的滑雪杖

蓋文・普雷蒂斯 作

我看著自己的滑雪杖
在鎮上無數雙手間，迴轉穿行。
霓虹色的杖身貼滿閃電貼紙，
叫人一眼就看見。

我拿它們換了一支小手電筒，
事實證明，它很適合收集
灰塵和蜘蛛網，
在那堆靠電池維生的器具之間。

起初，我的滑雪杖勤奮工作，
在翻過的田裡戳出孔洞，
讓種子安身、生長，
長成某種希望。

source:
Then, someone said “let there be light”
And parted the curtains 
in the rec center,
The sound of rusty hooks scratching 
Down my ski pole rods.

Now, they are coveted like guns
Between two not-quite-soldiers
Who sharpened them into not-quite-spears 
To fend off not-quite-enemies.

Who knew the apocalypse 
Would make my neon ski poles
Even more radical.

後來，有人說：「要有光。」
便在休閒中心裡
拉開窗簾，
生鏽的掛鉤沿著我的杖身
刮出聲響。

如今，它們像槍一樣令人垂涎，
握在兩個不太算士兵的人手裡。
他們將它們削成不太算矛的矛，
抵擋不太算敵人的敵人。

誰能想到，世界末日
竟讓我的霓虹滑雪杖
變得更加激進。

Townhall Meeting Minutes - Sunday, February 12, 2061

Chief Deborah Wolf, Secretary Wendy Greeves, Community Officers Mandy Lakota, Harris O’Neil and Paul Weissman were present. Another death is announced. Mayor Wolf discusses regional reports and population. Council Member Harris reports on looting. Council Member Mandy discusses overdue books.   

- Prayer/moment of silence for Helene Souza, murdered by three raiders for resisting sexual assault; burial set for Wednesday afternoon. Two other victims are recovering from sexual assault  

- Chief Wolf reports on rapidly growing violence in region per outside sources. Raiders and gangs emboldened and armed. Town population has grown to 313 (mostly travelers turned settlers) 

- Proposal from Chief Wolf to double town defense force and allocate resources to training/readiness – “we are sitting ducks”

- Officer O’Neil warns of massive rise in looting of town’s supplies in rec center

- Officer O’Neil  goes on record to oppose town defense expansion; wants to allocate resources to expanding crop yields – best solution for looting, trade and growth 

- Officer Lakokta urges all those in attendance to return overdue books; library is greatest source of knowledge in this day and age – “do not rob each other of growth”

- Officer Lakokta will begin publicly shaming those who do not return books

- Following unanimous vote, town officially renamed to Fort Asbury

我們逃出鎮了。

天還沒亮，蓋文就聽到鎮中心的教堂鐘聲——有掠奪者。我們聞到鎮公所方向飄來的煙味。幾分鐘後，保羅・欣克利開著鎮上僅剩三輛卡車中的一輛，穿過我們的社區，不停按喇叭，喊著要大家到加油站集合參戰……有幾十名襲擊者正在搶掠殺人。

source: No longer am I second guessing the decision to barter our little hand crank radio for four books on wilderness survival. Tomorrow we’re going deeper into the game lands and saying goodbye to Pine Hills Park. Winter will prove… difficult.

source: It’ll be dark soon. Heather tries to fashion a tent. Gavin struggles with starting a small fire. We’re working through the tears. We left friends and all we ever knew. But we all agreed to this plan the more we heard about the world burning around us. Worst coming to worse. How is society safe anymore?
target: 天快黑了。海瑟試著搭帳篷，蓋文費力地生一小堆火。我們邊哭邊做事，拋下了朋友，以及熟悉的一切。但隨著耳邊傳來越來越多世界陷入火海的消息，我們早已同意這項計畫。最壞的情況終於到來。這樣的社會，還有什麼安全可言？

source: We grabbed our go-packs and ran into Pine Hills Park, like we planned if the town were ever in danger. Jackets, medicine, books, water, crackers, dried fruit, flashlights, matches, small pots, and toilet paper… and I have a small hatchet, a map, a folding shovel and a couple tarps for a tent.
